lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review week 2 by combining a short past narrative, current status, and a future plan.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining what happened, what has changed, and what will happen next.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a compact update across past, present relevance, and future planning.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a practical issue from yesterday, its current status, and the plan for tomorrow.

main_focus.name: past, present relevance, and future review
main_focus.description: Use preteritum for what happened, perfekt for current status, and ska or tänker for next steps.
model_examples: Nu har de svarat, så i morgon ska jag hämta paketet.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use at least two examples each of preteritum, perfekt, and future-plan language.

vocabulary_target.theme: weekly tense review in a service situation
useful_chunks: I morgon ska jag hämta paketet.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Recycle tense-linked time markers and practical service words.

dialogue_shape.opening: A practical issue is introduced with a reference to yesterday.
dialogue_shape.middle: They explain what happened, what has changed now, and what action is planned next.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the next step and whether anything remains unclear.

target_complexity.repetition: review tense choices through a coherent practical update

focus: what has changed in the current situation

sentence_focus: one sentence with i går plus preteritum
one sentence with nu har plus supine
one sentence with i morgon ska
one sentence saying something is almost ready
one sentence summarizing the next step
